introduction.goalContent: Orchestrate efficient data pipelines and build Business Intelligence environments that transform information into actionable metrics, enabling smart, measurable, and real-time corporate decision-making.
introduction.journeyContent: I started my career consolidating data flows and analytics in the global manufacturing sector, where I reduced logistics error margins by 98% through database auditing, variable crossing, and dashboards in Excel/Power BI. Currently, I lead business intelligence in the ERP consulting sector, implementing extraction pipelines with SQL and Python to centralize commercial and financial KPIs, while developing statistical analyses aimed at solving problems in sectors like healthcare and research.
introduction.locationSubtitle: Base of operations and geographic availability
introduction.aboutContent:
I am a data analyst specializing in Business Intelligence and information architecture. I transform raw data volumes into strategic decisions. My focus lies in auditing databases, structuring information flows, and building dynamic dashboards that eliminate uncertainty in the corporate environment.

By incorporating these analytical capabilities, my work provides companies with enhanced operational visibility. By integrating accurate metrics and trend analysis, I facilitate better data clarity for executives and technical teams to make decisions. This not only optimizes resource performance and reduces bottlenecks, but also ensures that every business strategy is backed by quantifiable evidence.

img5.title: Budget Control
img5.desc: I develop an analytical solution for data extraction and processing for the finance department to mitigate operational risks by monitoring variances between actual and budgeted expenses. I automate the flow of information from accounts payable invoices and general journal entries from the Oracle system, consolidating and normalizing dispersed catalogs through relational databases in SQL Server. I transform these operational data into datasets and calculate them automatically, generating clean reports that facilitate advanced cash flow analysis and empower decision making.

img3.title: Labels
img3.desc: Desktop application developed for the Warehouse area to improve supplier traceability for each product. It queries Oracle via API using the order number to retrieve the Supplier Part Number and Daikin Part Number, then sends the data to the printer to generate a label including a barcode for easy scanning. Label generation was implemented using iText NuGet 5.5.13.5. The system includes a JSON configuration file that allows users to adjust the label size without requiring code changes. Reduced process time by over 50%.

img4.title: MasterLabels Analysis
img4.desc: I develop an analytical platform focused on diagnosing and resolving a critical quality issue that caused the printing of 8,000 blank labels per month. I structure the ingestion of large volumes of data by capturing granular variables from each label, exporting and transforming this information into dashboards and pivot tables for evaluation. Through this multidimensional analysis, I isolate patterns, identify failure trends in specific lines, and discover the technical root cause through data. This precise diagnosis supports a structural adjustment in the Oracle environment, reducing the logistics failure rate to less than 100 occurrences monthly.

img2.title: Overtime Request
img2.desc: I manage and optimize a data processing platform oriented to the finance area, designed to calculate the costs generated by logistics services during overtime. I process and cross-reference multiple structured variables—such as personnel records, transport routes, and times—to automate precise financial calculations. This structuring of information facilitates expense control, improves budget visibility, and speeds up data-backed internal audit processes.

img1.title: Data Architecture and ERP Ecosystem
img1.desc: I analyze and architect the core relational model in PostgreSQL for the deployment of the ERP ecosystem. I translate the business rules and operational processes of the company into a normalized database structure, guaranteeing information integrity and optimizing performance for the ingestion, connection, and report extraction from large volumes of data among different departments.

img2.title: Data Performance Monitor
img2.desc: I develop an analytical tool aimed at continuously auditing and monitoring database integrity and overall technological ecosystem health. I extract and process performance metrics to proactively identify bottlenecks in information ingestion, ensuring that commercial and financial data flows are always available, clean, and ready for analysis.

img3.title: SAJI Analytical Dashboards
img3.desc: I build and implement comprehensive Business Intelligence solutions through the development of multidimensional analytical dashboards. I extract and transform raw operational data into real-time interactive visualizations, allowing detailed tracking of critical KPIs in key areas such as Sales, Inventory, and Finance, which helps management evaluate employee performance, track goals, and make corporate decisions based entirely on data.

wids2025.name: WiDS Datathon 2025
wids2025.short: ADHD Predictive Analysis in Adolescent Females
wids2025.description: Deep data cleaning, exploratory analysis, and medical data modeling focused on identifying clinical patterns for ADHD detection, mitigating diagnostic bias.
wids2025.h1: Deep data cleaning and preprocessing of complex medical datasets.
wids2025.h2: Variable importance analysis (Feature Engineering) to identify relevant neurological factors.

img1.title: WiDS Datathon 2025: ADHD Predictive Analysis
img1.desc: I design and execute a comprehensive pipeline of cleaning, normalization, and exploratory analysis on complex medical and neuroimaging datasets. I identify statistical correlations and isolate key neurological variables using feature engineering techniques, feeding a predictive model (XGBoost) designed to timely detect ADHD in adolescent females. I guarantee the validity of the results by evaluating exact analytical metrics and confusion matrices, ensuring that the findings extracted from the data are fully interpretable and actionable for public health environments.

wids2025.stack: Python, Pandas, Statistical Analysis, Data Cleaning

wids2022.name: WiDS Datathon 2022
wids2022.description: Statistical analysis of medical and sociodemographic datasets to forecast clinical diagnosis times.
wids2022.h1: Extraction and normalization of fragmented clinical records.
wids2022.h2: Demographic data crossing and analytical validation using AUC-ROC metrics.

img1.title: WiDS Datathon 2022: Data-Driven Oncological Analysis
img1.desc: I execute detailed statistical analyses in Python focused on early breast cancer detection. I process and audit large medical and sociodemographic datasets using advanced normalization, cleaning, and variable crossing techniques. The analytical goal is to forecast definitive diagnoses in periods of less than 90 days, rigorously validating the statistical reliability of the extracted data using AUC-ROC performance curves to bring mathematical precision to oncological decisions.

wids2022.stack: Python, Data Normalization, Pandas, Demographic Analysis
